name: ClinGen_search_gene_validity
description: Search ClinGen gene-disease validity curations by gene symbol. Returns classification (Definitive, Strong, Moderate, Limited, Disputed, Refuted), disease associations, and inheritance patterns. Essential for ACMG variant classification. Example: BRCA1 returns validity scores for hereditary breast/ovarian cancer. The `gene` parameter takes an HGNC GENE SYMBOL only: this file carries no coordinate, transcript or ontology index, so a region, an Ensembl id, a RefSeq accession or an HGVS expression is refused with an error rather than answered with an empty result. Resolve a region to symbols first (Ensembl_get_region_features with feature_types='gene').

gene.description: Gene symbol to search (e.g., BRCA1, TP53, CFTR). HGNC symbol only (e.g. BRCA1). A genomic range, Ensembl id, RefSeq accession or HGVS expression is refused with an error naming what to convert it with -- it is not answered with an empty list, which would be indistinguishable from an uncurated gene.

name: ClinGen_get_gene_validity
description: Get ClinGen gene-disease validity curations with classifications (Definitive, Strong, Moderate, Limited). The full catalog contains thousands of rows and is paged with limit/offset; total and next_offset make every curation reachable. An optional exact gene-symbol filter is available. The `gene` parameter takes an HGNC GENE SYMBOL only: this file carries no coordinate, transcript or ontology index, so a region, an Ensembl id, a RefSeq accession or an HGVS expression is refused with an error rather than answered with an empty result. Resolve a region to symbols first (Ensembl_get_region_features with feature_types='gene').

gene.description: Optional: Filter by gene symbol. HGNC symbol only (e.g. BRCA1). A genomic range, Ensembl id, RefSeq accession or HGVS expression is refused with an error naming what to convert it with -- it is not answered with an empty list, which would be indistinguishable from an uncurated gene.

offset.description: Zero-based curation offset. Continue with next_offset while has_more is true.

DISEASE LABEL.description: The disease the gene was assessed for.

MOI.description: Mode of inheritance, e.g. 'AD', 'AR'. The validity classification is for THIS gene-disease-inheritance triple, not for the gene alone.

SOP.description: Which version of ClinGen's standard operating procedure was used. Classifications made under different SOPs are not strictly comparable.

CLASSIFICATION.description: The verdict: 'Definitive', 'Strong', 'Moderate', 'Limited', 'Disputed', 'Refuted', 'No Known Disease Relationship'. 'Limited' and 'Disputed' are not weak yeses -- they are reasons not to report a variant in that gene.

CLASSIFICATION DATE.description: When it was classified. ClinGen re-curates, so an old date may predate the evidence that settled the question.

GCEP.description: The Gene Curation Expert Panel that made the call.

ONLINE REPORT.description: The full report, where the evidence behind the verdict is set out.

name: ClinGen_search_dosage_sensitivity
description: Search ClinGen dosage sensitivity curations by gene symbol. Returns haploinsufficiency (HI) and triplosensitivity (TS) scores (0-3 scale). Score 3 = Sufficient evidence for dosage pathogenicity. Critical for CNV interpretation. Example: MECP2 has HI score of 3. The `gene` parameter takes an HGNC GENE SYMBOL only: this file carries no coordinate, transcript or ontology index, so a region, an Ensembl id, a RefSeq accession or an HGVS expression is refused with an error rather than answered with an empty result. Resolve a region to symbols first (Ensembl_get_region_features with feature_types='gene').

gene.description: Gene symbol to search (e.g., MECP2, PMP22, RAI1). HGNC symbol only (e.g. BRCA1). A genomic range, Ensembl id, RefSeq accession or HGVS expression is refused with an error naming what to convert it with -- it is not answered with an empty list, which would be indistinguishable from an uncurated gene.

name: ClinGen_get_dosage_sensitivity
description: Get ClinGen dosage sensitivity curations, including haploinsufficiency and triplosensitivity scores. The catalog is paged with limit/offset; total and next_offset make every curation reachable. Set include_regions=true to include recurrent CNV regions. The `gene` parameter takes an HGNC GENE SYMBOL only: this file carries no coordinate, transcript or ontology index, so a region, an Ensembl id, a RefSeq accession or an HGVS expression is refused with an error rather than answered with an empty result. Resolve a region to symbols first (Ensembl_get_region_features with feature_types='gene').

gene.description: Optional: Filter by gene symbol. HGNC symbol only (e.g. BRCA1). A genomic range, Ensembl id, RefSeq accession or HGVS expression is refused with an error naming what to convert it with -- it is not answered with an empty list, which would be indistinguishable from an uncurated gene.

offset.description: Zero-based curation offset. Continue with next_offset while has_more is true.

HAPLOINSUFFICIENCY.description: Evidence that LOSS of one copy causes disease, as ClinGen's score. This is what decides whether a deletion is reportable.

TRIPLOSENSITIVITY.description: Evidence that GAIN of a copy causes disease. Independent of haploinsufficiency -- a gene can be one and not the other, so a duplication cannot be judged on the deletion score.

name: ClinGen_get_actionability_adult
description: Get ClinGen clinical actionability curations for adult context, including actionable findings, intervention scores, and outcome scores. Results are paged with limit/offset; total and next_offset make every curation reachable.

offset.description: Zero-based curation offset. Continue with next_offset while has_more is true.

name: ClinGen_get_actionability_pediatric
description: Get ClinGen clinical actionability curations for pediatric context, including actionable findings, intervention recommendations, and evidence scores. Results are paged with limit/offset; total and next_offset make every curation reachable.

offset.description: Zero-based curation offset. Continue with next_offset while has_more is true.

name: ClinGen_search_actionability
description: Search ClinGen clinical actionability across both adult and pediatric contexts by gene. Returns actionability data from both contexts for comparison. Useful for comprehensive actionability assessment of a gene across age groups. The `gene` parameter takes an HGNC GENE SYMBOL only: this file carries no coordinate, transcript or ontology index, so a region, an Ensembl id, a RefSeq accession or an HGVS expression is refused with an error rather than answered with an empty result. Resolve a region to symbols first (Ensembl_get_region_features with feature_types='gene').

gene.description: Gene symbol to search (e.g., BRCA1, MLH1, LDLR). HGNC symbol only (e.g. BRCA1). A genomic range, Ensembl id, RefSeq accession or HGVS expression is refused with an error naming what to convert it with -- it is not answered with an empty list, which would be indistinguishable from an uncurated gene.

failed_contexts.description: Maps context name (Adult/Pediatric) to the fetch error. Present only on partial or total failure.

note.description: Present when some but not all contexts failed: warns that the failed context's count of 0 means 'not retrieved', not 'no curation exists'.

name: ClinGen_get_variant_classifications
description: Get variant pathogenicity classifications from ClinGen Evidence Repository. Returns expert-curated variant classifications with supporting evidence. Optional filters by gene or variant. Classifications follow ACMG/AMP guidelines with expert review. Results are paged with limit/offset: 'total' counts every matching classification, and 'has_more' / 'next_offset' give the next page. CAID and ClinVar Variation ID lookups also return the CAID, mode of inheritance, met/unmet ACMG criteria, evidence summary, dates, version and HGVS forms. The `gene` parameter takes an HGNC GENE SYMBOL only: this file carries no coordinate, transcript or ontology index, so a region, an Ensembl id, a RefSeq accession or an HGVS expression is refused with an error rather than answered with an empty result. Resolve a region to symbols first (Ensembl_get_region_features with feature_types='gene').

gene.description: Optional: Filter by gene symbol. HGNC symbol only (e.g. BRCA1). A genomic range, Ensembl id, RefSeq accession or HGVS expression is refused with an error naming what to convert it with -- it is not answered with an empty list, which would be indistinguishable from an uncurated gene.

variant.description: Optional: filter to one variant. Accepts a ClinGen canonical allele ID ('CA16020993', with or without a 'CAR:' prefix), a ClinVar VariationID ('370074'), full HGVS ('NM_000277.3:c.1315+1G>T'), or a protein change ('p.Arg408Trp'). The form supplied selects the matching server-side filter. HGVS and protein-change strings match on substring, so a short fragment can return many rows -- combine with 'gene' to scope them.

limit.description: Maximum classifications to return from this page

offset.description: Zero-based classification offset; follow next_offset for later records

Guidelines.description: WHICH specification was applied. A pathogenicity call under the ENIGMA BRCA1 panel's version 1.0.0 of the ACMG/AMP guidelines is a different claim from one under the generic rules.

Warnings.description: The curator's warnings on this interpretation, dropped whole before. One of BRCA1's reads "Gene obtained from curated document aligns with the Allele Registry but not with ClinVar data" -- a stated disagreement with ClinVar about a pathogenicity classification.
